preprocessing.filter_scope: each isolated four-second trial; no learned statistics

probability_schema.tie_rule: first class on exact probability tie

work_block: Day3-4 bounded development continuation after explicit continue
scope: Exploratory successor after exposed Day2; no confirmation or scientific promotion
history_rng: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([history_draw_seed, subject_id])); class0 permutation then class1; nested prefixes

selection.analysis: leave-one-development-person-out; average two draws within person before selection and reporting
selection.additional_policy: dose-specific classical pipeline chosen on other11 people, no heldout-person labels used for choice
selection.ties: BA within1e-12: smaller measured practical-arm mean fit+predict cost per evaluated person, then model_order; calibration ties use declared descending prior order
selection.pooled_selection: all12 development values reported only as resubstitution/selection candidate; no confirmation selector frozen

bootstrap.scope: paired person percentile descriptive only; repeated-source, overlapping selector-training sets, prior exploration not covered; no scientific significance inference

null_control.scope: evaluation-label shuffles within subject shared across model/dose/draw; no refitting or reselection; scorer sanity only

decision.SELECTION_SIGNAL: LOPO Mixed point gain >=0.02 against all3 original comparators; exploratory clue for protocol review only
decision.CALIBRATION_ONLY: selection signal absent; selected calibration n30 gain>=0.02 and that gain minus pooled TS-LR n30 gain>=0.02; useful-history clue, not mechanism identification or selection success
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: neither prespecified point signal met; no zero-effect or scientific KILL inference
decision.scientific_target: unchanged all3-comparator>=2pp point gain plus corrected CI conditions on future sealed confirmation

exclusions: No outcome-based exclusions, new seeds, online segment, confirmation data or external cohort
outcomes_viewed_before_freeze: Day2 eight-person outcomes exposed; no successor outcomes viewed
